ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Rundll32.EXE Execution of UDL File
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of rundll32.exe with the oledb32.dll library to open a UDL file.
Threat actors can abuse this technique as a phishing vector to capture authentication credentials or other sensitive data.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*oledb32\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\,OpenDSLFile\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\.udl$")))
